### 新功能

- 桌面控件：时钟、计算器、便笺、终端小窗，从悬浮球转盘或托盘「🧩 桌面控件」打开；位置、大小、叠放顺序、开着没有都会记住，重启后原样摆回来。默认不置顶，每个控件可以单独设置顶。
- 时钟：表盘或数字两种样式，秒针、年月日、星期、本年第几周、24 小时制都能单独开关。
- 计算器：标准、科学、统计、进制换算四种模式；小数位数可设、千分位显示、点结果复制；历史记录各模式共用，点一条回到当时的模式和输入。最多开 5 个，「＋」照当前设置再开一个。
- 便笺：最多 50 张，每张一个小窗；标题、最后修改时间、背景色可设；任意一行可以设成待办（行首圆圈，点了打勾划掉）；「📥 归档」存成「标题.txt」放进归档文件夹并删掉这张。
- 便笺归档：工具工坊里新工具「🗒️ 便笺归档」（便笺的 ⋯ 里也能直达），列出归档的便笺，可按标题或内容筛选、直接查看内容、打开所在位置、恢复成桌面便笺或删除。
- 终端小窗：里面是真正的 CMD / PowerShell / pwsh，可设工作目录、启动命令、标题、退出后自动重启；最多开 20 个；梭哈退出时里面的程序一起结束，下次启动按设置重新跑。
- 控件可以单独「─ 隐藏」或「✕ 关闭」（关闭会真的删掉；便笺有内容、终端在运行时先问一句）；悬浮球上一格管一整类，「全部显示」时单独藏起来的也一起出来。
- 控件四个角都能拉大小；便笺、计算器、终端标题条最左边有拖动把手，控件再窄都能按住它挪位置。
- 控件置顶时会看背后的颜色自动换深色或浅色卡片，压在什么背景上都看得清；取消置顶回到主题配色。
- 悬浮球超级环：转盘可以分里外两圈，也可以全部放一圈，在设置里拖动决定每圈放什么、什么顺序；每圈够两样会多一格「🗂️ 全部」，一下全部显示或全部隐藏；拖出最外圈松手可以设成算取消。
- 左键双击悬浮球切换主界面：没显示时打开并提到最前，已显示时收回托盘。
- 待办提醒浮窗里双击某一条，主界面直接打开这条待办的详情；双击标题或空白处打开待办管家（浮窗平时鼠标穿透，按住 Alt 才点得到）。
- 托盘新增「🎯 找回悬浮球」：摆回主屏左边界中间、置顶并闪几下。
- 键鼠增强（设置里打开，默认关）：快速晃鼠标时光标放大或冒出光环，方便找到光标；同一方向快速连续滚动时，鼠标旁边浮出「到顶 / 上一页 / 下一页 / 到底」胶囊，翻的是鼠标底下那一块。
- 增强滚动灵敏度五档：很灵敏、灵敏、标准、迟钝、很迟钝。
- 录屏带声音：可以录系统正在播放的声音，也可以再加上麦克风；暂停的那段不录，声音和画面对得上。
- 工具工坊「文本格式化」可以按关键字或正则替换。

### 改进

- 录屏占用大幅降低：满屏动画时 CPU 占用降到原来的六分之一左右，长时间录制不再越录越卡、越录越占内存。
- 停止录屏或 GIF 后马上就能再截图、再录，剩下的收尾在后台做，右下角小卡片显示进度，做完可以直接打开文件或所在文件夹。
- 滚动截长图又准又快：动画、懒加载图片、内层滚动区域、缩放后的网页都能一行不漏不重地拼好，同一张长网页从十几到几十秒降到五六秒。
- 悬浮球图标自动抠图：透明背景原样显示，白底或黑底的标志自动去掉底色，照片裁成平滑的圆，不再有黑底和锯齿。
- 悬浮球任何屏幕边都能贴；两块屏相接的边和任务栏那侧只贴齐不缩进，不会再找不到；置顶不会再丢；第一次或位置失效时出现在主屏左边中间。
- 悬浮球可以对调左右键（左键挪位置、右键出转盘）。
- 浮窗的开关统一到悬浮球上，设置、时区查看、记忆大师里不再各有一个开关。
- 排班管理挪进工具工坊。
- 闭环和待办的图片附件可以直接 Ctrl+V 粘贴截图或复制的图片，点缩略图在工具内看大图、左右翻页。
- 日期选择统一成同一种月历，带「今天、三天后、一周后」这类快捷选项。
- 后台挂着时 CPU 和磁盘占用更低：没人用搜索时文件索引不再频繁重建，浮窗的后台检查在空闲时放慢。
- 增强滚动的「到顶 / 到底」改成一页页翻过去，Outlook、Excel 这类列表不会再跳回顶部；读不到滚动位置的程序到头就停，不再连续发出提示音。
- Excel、WPS 表格默认不出增强滚动胶囊（表格往下没有底）。
- 转盘拖回中心（或贴边时拖回按下的位置）会清空选择，松手什么都不做。

### 修复

- 转盘拖出去时偶尔自己「松手」、开错或什么都没开。
- 悬浮球贴在两块屏相接的边上之后找不到。
- 悬浮球右键菜单点外面不收起。
- 悬浮球开关时钟、临时文本偶尔没反应。
- 终端小窗拖不动。
- 时钟设置面板点外面不收起。
- 超级剪贴板选中记录回车后偶尔没粘上；鼠标悬停预览和键盘选择互相抢。
- 录屏暂停着点停止时总时长多算。
- 导出或发给 AI 的待办清单遇到中文截止时间时程序退出。
- 局域网互传、日志、缩略图缓存等多处安全和占用问题：复制的文字不再写进日志，日志只留最近 10 份。

### 去掉

- 临时文本的悬浮编辑窗，由「便笺」桌面控件接替；工具工坊里的临时文本照旧。

### New

- Desktop widgets: clock, calculator, notes and mini terminal, opened from the float launcher ring or the tray's "🧩 Desktop widgets". Position, size, stacking order and open state are remembered and restored after a restart. Not on top by default; each widget can be pinned on its own.
- Clock: analog or digital, with separate switches for seconds, date, weekday, week of the year and 24-hour time.
- Calculator: standard, scientific, statistics and base-conversion modes; configurable decimals, thousands separators, click a result to copy; shared history that takes you back to the mode and input of that entry. Up to 5, and "+" opens another with the same settings.
- Notes: up to 50, each in its own small window; title, last-modified time and background color; any line can become a to-do (click the circle to check it off); "📥 Archive" saves it as "title.txt" in the archive folder and removes the note.
- Archived notes: a new "🗒️ Archived notes" tool in the Workshop (also reachable from a note's ⋯ menu) lists archived notes, filters by title or content, shows the text, opens the file location, restores a note to the desktop or deletes it.
- Mini terminal: a real CMD / PowerShell / pwsh with working folder, startup command, title and auto-restart; up to 20; its programs end when Suoha exits and run again on the next start.
- Each widget can be hidden ("─") or closed ("✕", which really removes it; notes with content and running terminals ask first). One slot on the float launcher shows or hides a whole kind, including ones hidden individually.
- All four corners of a widget resize it; notes, calculator and terminal have a drag grip at the left of the title bar, so they can always be moved however narrow they are.
- While pinned on top, widgets switch to a dark or light card depending on what's behind them, so they stay readable; unpinning returns to the theme colors.
- Float launcher wheel: one or two rings, with the contents and order of each ring set by dragging in Settings; rings with two or more items get a "🗂️ All" slot that shows or hides everything at once; releasing outside the wheel can be set to cancel.
- Double-click the float launcher with the left button to toggle the main window: open and bring it to the front, or send it back to the tray.
- Double-click a to-do in the reminder float to open its details in the main window; double-click the title or empty space to open To-dos (the float is click-through unless you hold Alt).
- New tray item "🎯 Find float launcher": puts it back at the middle of the primary screen's left edge, on top, and flashes it.
- Mouse helpers (off by default, in Settings): shake the mouse to enlarge the cursor or show a ring around it; scroll quickly in one direction to get a capsule with Top / Page up / Page down / Bottom that scrolls the area under the mouse.
- Five scroll-boost sensitivity levels.
- Screen recordings have sound: system audio, optionally mixed with the microphone; paused parts are skipped and audio stays in sync.
- Workshop "Text format" can replace by keyword or regular expression.

### Improvements

- Screen recording uses far less resources: about a sixth of the CPU for full-screen motion, and long recordings no longer slow down or eat memory.
- After stopping a recording or GIF you can capture again right away; finishing happens in the background with a small progress card that offers to open the file or its folder.
- Scrolling capture is accurate and fast on animated pages, lazy-loaded images, inner scroll areas and zoomed pages; a long page now takes about 5–6 seconds instead of tens of seconds.
- Float launcher icons are cut out automatically: transparent backgrounds stay, white or black backgrounds behind logos are removed, photos become a smooth circle — no more dark fill or jagged edges.
- The float launcher snaps to any screen edge; edges shared by two screens and the taskbar side no longer tuck it away; it stays on top; it starts at the middle of the primary screen's left edge when it has no valid position.
- Left and right buttons of the float launcher can be swapped.
- Floating windows are turned on and off from the float launcher only; the separate switches in Settings, Time zones and Memory Master are gone.
- Shift scheduling moved into the Workshop.
- Image attachments in loops and to-dos can be pasted with Ctrl+V, and thumbnails open in an in-app viewer with left / right paging.
- Date fields share one calendar picker with shortcuts such as Today, In 3 days and In a week.
- Lower CPU and disk use in the background: the file index is rebuilt rarely when search isn't used, and floating-window checks slow down when idle.
- Scroll boost Top / Bottom pages through instead of jumping, so Outlook and Excel lists no longer jump back to the top; apps whose position can't be read stop at the end without repeated beeps.
- Excel and WPS Spreadsheets don't get the scroll-boost capsule by default (sheets have no bottom).
- Dragging the wheel back to the center (or back to where you pressed near a screen edge) clears the selection, and releasing there does nothing.

### Fixes

- The wheel sometimes "released" by itself when dragged out, opening the wrong thing or nothing.
- The float launcher couldn't be found after snapping to an edge shared by two screens.
- The float launcher's right-click menu didn't close when clicking outside.
- Toggling the clock or temporary text from the float launcher sometimes did nothing.
- The mini terminal couldn't be dragged.
- The clock's settings panel didn't close when clicking outside.
- Picking a clipboard history entry and pressing Enter sometimes didn't paste; hover preview and keyboard selection fought each other.
- Stopping a paused recording counted the pause in the duration.
- Exporting or sending the to-do list to AI could exit the app on non-ASCII deadlines.
- Several safety and resource issues in LAN transfer, logging and thumbnail caching: copied text is no longer written to logs, and only the last 10 log files are kept.

### Removed

- The floating editor for temporary text, replaced by the Notes desktop widget; temporary text in the Workshop stays.
